autonomous_induction_events.mechanistic_diagnosis: C0 treats the two-branch linear Prony law as sufficient even after the calibrated stress crosses yield. C1 retains that baseline and adds a signed hold-overstress term and an accumulated plastic-work term, with matching initial-rate contributions. The guard must check both the entire calibrated loading history and the current hold: a specimen can unload below yield while retaining a plastic-work contribution. Hold-only excess separates the supplied witnesses but misses history-only crossings; the history integral captures accumulated loading but misses hold-only crossings. The combined history-and-hold excess is zero on all C0 passes and 3.53130001 on the failure, with zero as the physical boundary. The matrix, circulation, Robin-boundary, advection, and nuisance-conditioning features are unavailable in these witnesses and do not express the yield criterion. Missingness is not a yield mechanism and does not separate the witnesses.

autonomous_induction_events.mechanistic_diagnosis: C0 applies the sub-yield two-branch Prony law outside its valid regime. After per-lab stress calibration, C0 is valid only if the absolute stress at every past step and at the current hold is at most the declared yield stress. Any strict exceedance selects C1, which retains the Prony response and adds signed quadratic hold overstress and a transient driven by accumulated plastic work times the calibrated hold stress, with matching initial-rate terms. A specimen can therefore require C1 even after unloading below yield. The history-and-hold excess is zero for all three C0 passes and 4.33112966 for the failure. Hold-only excess separates these witnesses but misses prior-only yielding; the temporal history integral measures accumulated exposure but misses hold-only yielding. Neither matrix feature, any of the three circulation-related features, Robin asymmetry, the Péclet proxy, nor nuisance conditioning supplies a constitutive trigger here. Panel missingness is handled by imputation and does not govern yielding.

autonomous_induction_events.mechanistic_diagnosis: C0 assumes that two-branch linear Prony creep is sufficient. That assumption holds only when every calibrated past stress and the current hold stress are at or below yield in absolute value. C1 adds signed quadratic hold overstress and a transient driven by time-integrated past plastic work. The history term can remain active after unloading below yield. The joint history-and-hold excess is zero in all three C0 successes and 2.95995568 in the failure. Hold-only excess also separates these witnesses but misses prior-only overstress; the temporal history integral measures past loading but misses hold-only overstress. The two matrix metrics, three circulation or combined vortex metrics, Robin asymmetry, Péclet proxy, and nuisance condition number are unavailable here and do not define yielding. Panel missingness affects imputation, not the constitutive regime. Both alpha wings calibrate the stresses used by the guard and the coupon inputs; the auxiliary bench and acoustic sentinel do not.

autonomous_induction_events.mechanistic_diagnosis: C0 assumes the linear two-branch Prony law is sufficient even after yielding. It is sufficient only when every calibrated historical stress and current hold has absolute magnitude at or below the declared yield stress. C1 retains the Prony response and adds signed squared hold overstress and a transient driven by accumulated plastic work times the current hold, with matching initial-rate terms. Prior overstress can therefore activate C1 even when the hold is subyield. The calibrated history-and-hold maximum is zero on all C0 successes and 3.26200715 on the C0 failure. Hold-only excess misses unloaded histories, and the history integral measures plastic work but misses hold-only yielding. The two matrix features, three circulation-related features, Robin asymmetry, Péclet proxy, and nuisance condition number are unavailable; coupon missingness concerns alignment, not yielding.

autonomous_induction_events.mechanistic_diagnosis: C0's separable Sylvester operator at nominal diffusivity is valid only in the quiescent laminar regime. The negative witness has both a nonseparable reaction residual ratio of 0.54134823 and a peak historical circulation excess of 1.0882; either independently requires C1's coupled 2D operator with 1.45× diffusivity on both axes. The combined excess is zero for all three C0 passes and positive for the failure. The residual ratio detects cross-coupling, but cannot detect vortex memory by itself; the historical circulation maximum detects vortex memory, but cannot detect cross-coupling by itself. Terminal circulation can miss a relaxed vortex, and the Frobenius norm is nonzero even for an additive potential. The three hold/loading features and panel missingness are unavailable and do not encode this switch. Robin asymmetry is unchanged, while the Péclet proxy and nuisance condition number lie within the C0-pass ranges. The physical specification does not assign a regime for a residual ratio in (1e-6, 1e-4] without a historical circulation exceedance.

autonomous_induction_events.mechanistic_diagnosis: C0's separable Sylvester solve with baseline diffusivity is valid only for additive reaction and a circulation history that never exceeds critical. C1 uses the full coupled 2D operator and scales both diffusivities by 1.45 when either the additive residual ratio exceeds 1e-4 or any prior circulation exceeds critical. An earlier vortex can therefore activate C1 even when the terminal circulation is low and the potential is separable. Use the combined feature as the maximum of the positive excesses above the two activation thresholds. It is zero on all C0 witnesses and 1.0785 on the C1 witness. The zero guard applies to the declared regimes; with subcritical history, the specification does not assign residual ratios in (1e-6, 1e-4] to either regime. The Frobenius norm measures magnitude, not coupling. The residual ratio and full-history circulation excess each miss the other activation route, and terminal circulation misses relaxed vortices. Robin asymmetry is unchanged, the Péclet proxy overlaps, and nuisance conditioning is not a physical switch. The three loading-history features and panel missingness are unavailable and do not encode the stated switch.

autonomous_induction_events.mechanistic_diagnosis: C0's separable, unit-diffusivity forward model fails when either the reaction potential has genuine 2D cross-coupling or any past circulation exceeds the critical value. C1 uses the full 2D reaction diagonal and scales both diffusivities by 1.45 when either trigger fires. The combined feature is 0 in all three C0 passes and 1.0773 in the failure. The residual ratio alone misses separable post-vortex batches; the history maximum alone misses cross-coupling without a vortex; terminal circulation forgets earlier peaks. The Frobenius norm measures magnitude, not separability. Robin asymmetry is unchanged, the Péclet proxy is not a regime trigger, and the nuisance condition number falls within the passing range. The three loading-history features and panel missingness are unavailable. The zero guard boundary represents the OR of the two physical excesses, not a common tolerance on the raw residual ratio and circulation: laminar requires a residual ratio at most 1e-6 and no prior circulation exceedance; C1 is required above a residual ratio of 1e-4 or for any positive circulation exceedance. The specification does not assign the intermediate residual band when circulation never exceeds critical.

autonomous_induction_events.mechanistic_diagnosis: C0 keeps both diffusivities at 1.00× even when it adds the full 2D reaction map. C1 uses the coupled Kronecker operator with the full reaction diagonal and 1.45× diffusivity on both axes when either the additive residual ratio exceeds 1e-4 or any past circulation exceeds critical. A quiet terminal sample does not erase an earlier crossing. C0's laminar law is established when the residual ratio is at most 1e-6 and the entire trace is at or below critical. Use the combined excess as a threshold-adjusted OR signal: it is positive if either eddy trigger fires and zero in the laminar witnesses. The witnesses give 0 for C0 and 1.0667 for C1. With no circulation crossing, the residual band (1e-6, 1e-4] is unspecified; a nonpositive score does not establish laminarity there. The residual ratio alone misses vortex memory, historical circulation alone misses spatial coupling, and terminal circulation misses prior crossings. The Frobenius norm measures magnitude, not separability. Robin asymmetry is unchanged, and neither the Péclet proxy nor nuisance conditioning determines this regime. The three hold/loading features and panel missingness are unpopulated. Wing A and Wing B calibrate the four sensor banks used in the inversion.
